Class MarketReplayService

java.lang.Object
app.market.MarketReplayService
@Service public class MarketReplayService extends Object
Maintains shared simulation cursors and publishes bounded market-data responses.

    • setClock

      public MarketResponses.Snapshot setClock(Long requestedSessionId, Instant timestamp)
      Seeks the shared replay cursor to the closest seeded tick at or before an instant. Requests for non-trading dates inside an imported month use the nearest seeded day in that month, preferring the next seeded day.
      Parameters:
      requestedSessionId - optional completed simulation identifier
      timestamp - desired simulated market timestamp
      Returns:
      synchronized prices at the selected cursor
      Throws:
      MarketRequestException - when the month has no seeded trading data

    • subscribe

      public org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter subscribe(Long requestedSessionId, String clientId, Long lastEventId)
      Registers an SSE client and replays recoverable missed events when possible.
      Parameters:
      requestedSessionId - optional completed simulation identifier
      clientId - stable client address used for connection limiting
      lastEventId - optional last received event identifier
      Returns:
      the registered emitter

    • advance

      @Scheduled(fixedRateString="${market.replay.tick-millis:1000}") public void advance()
      Advances every active simulation cursor and publishes the next synchronized batch.
